us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: 19-year-old arrested after Virginia State University shooting wounds five
bullets: Police said Camron Harris, 19, was found hiding in a dormitory closet.
Five people were wounded, including one person critically injured.
The shooting triggered a campus lockdown as students prepared for the school year.

articles.title: Hurricane Lala skirts Hawaii’s Big Island after flooding roads
bullets: Lala passed Hawaii’s Big Island without making landfall.
Strong winds and heavy rain flooded roads and swelled rivers.
Forecasters warned of flooding, mudslides and dangerous surf into Sunday.

articles.title: Michigan shootings leave five victims and suspect dead
bullets: Police said a teenage boy and four adults were killed Friday.
The suspect, Chad Hickman, was later found dead in a wooded area.
A teenage girl survived and was reported in stable condition.

articles.title: US pulls last aircraft carrier from Asia amid Iran focus
bullets: The USS George Washington is leaving the Pacific for Middle East duty.
The move comes as the USS Abraham Lincoln remains extended for Iran operations.
Analysts said the deployment leaves the western Pacific temporarily without a US carrier.

articles.title: Democratic primary turnout surges in several midterm states
bullets: AP reported Democratic voters are turning out at unusually high primary levels.
Wisconsin Democrats cast nearly 800,000 ballots in Tuesday’s primary.
Michigan Democrats drew about 1.5 million voters the prior week.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Magnitude 7.7 quake off Indonesia kills at least 47
bullets: A powerful offshore earthquake struck Indonesia, according to AP.
Officials reported at least 47 deaths and building collapses.
Emergency teams continued assessing damage in affected areas.

articles.title: Taliban marks five years in power as UN warns of rights crisis
bullets: Taliban officials gathered in Kabul’s Loya Jirga hall for anniversary events.
The Taliban returned to power on August 15, 2021.
A UN official warned of a severe rights crisis, including girls barred from school after age 12.

articles.title: West Bank standoff highlights Israel’s handling of settler violence
bullets: AP reported on Israeli reluctance to curb settler violence in the West Bank.
The story examined political and security factors beyond Prime Minister Netanyahu.
Violence against Palestinians remains a major international concern.

articles.title: Venezuela releases 131 people detained for political reasons
bullets: Venezuela’s government said it released 131 political detainees.
The United States welcomed the move, according to AP’s Spanish-language report.
The releases came under an amnesty-law framework.

articles.title: UK leader calls for reflection after death of Jason Arday
bullets: Former Cambridge professor Jason Arday was found dead in south London.
Arday had resigned after scrutiny over alleged plagiarism and other claims.
UK political leaders called the episode a tragedy and urged reflection.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Kiren Rijiju shares ‘dimagi naxals’ list after Opposition jibe
bullets: Hindustan Times listed the story among its latest India headlines.
The report involved Union minister Kiren Rijiju and opposition criticism.
The item was updated within the last few hours on HT’s homepage.

articles.title: SAD’s Harsimrat shows weapon used in Nanded attack on Sukhbir Badal
bullets: Hindustan Times featured the story in its India News section.
The report concerned an attack on SAD chief Sukhbir Badal in Nanded.
HT marked the story as updated minutes before its latest crawl.

articles.title: Three children in ICU after ‘dead lizard’ found in birthday cake
bullets: Hindustan Times reported the case from Maharashtra.
The FDA raided the bakery after the incident was reported.
The story was updated within the last few hours.

articles.title: Mamata and Suvendu clash over Asish Banerjee death claim
bullets: Hindustan Times reported a political dispute in West Bengal.
The story centers on claims around ex-TMC MLA Asish Banerjee’s death.
HT listed it as a recently updated India News item.

articles.title: CJP volunteer’s father dies; son blames Bengal BJP workers
bullets: HT reported the death of a CJP volunteer’s father in Bengal.
The son blamed BJP workers, while Suvendu Adhikari said three people were held.
The story was listed among HT’s latest India News updates.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top US market movers and market-moving stories

articles.title: PepsiCo in focus after Elliott takes reported $4 billion stake
bullets: CNBC’s PepsiCo quote page listed Elliott’s stake as a latest item.
PepsiCo also appeared in CNBC’s premarket and midday movers lists.
The stock was highlighted alongside Biogen and other active names.

articles.title: Frontier Group leads CNBC midday movers list
bullets: CNBC listed Frontier Group among the biggest midday movers.
Kraft Heinz and Biogen were also highlighted in the same market-movers item.
The roundup appeared on CNBC’s stock market page.

articles.title: Apple rises on iPhone demand signals
bullets: CNBC’s Apple quote page cited strong iPhone demand signals.
Apple was also listed among CNBC’s biggest midday movers.
The stock’s quote page showed Apple trading near recent highs.

articles.title: Home Depot and Walmart earnings loom for Wall Street
bullets: AP previewed Home Depot and Walmart earnings for the week ahead.
The reports are set to test consumer and housing-related demand.
Fed meeting minutes are also due, adding macro focus for investors.

articles.title: Alphabet draws more Berkshire buying
bullets: Berkshire Hathaway increased its Alphabet stake in the second quarter.
AP reported Berkshire held roughly 106 million Alphabet shares by June 30.
The position was valued at about $37.76 billion in the filing.

articles.title: Berkshire boosts Alphabet and homebuilder stakes
bullets: Berkshire added about 48.1 million Alphabet shares in the second quarter.
The company also increased its Lennar stake by nearly 30%.
It established a small new D.R. Horton position.

articles.title: US inflation cooled in July but prices remain elevated
bullets: Consumer prices rose 3.4% from a year earlier in July.
That was down from 3.5% in June, according to the Labor Department.
AP noted households still face higher grocery and gasoline costs.

articles.title: Wall Street awaits retail earnings and Fed minutes
bullets: AP’s market preview highlighted Home Depot and Walmart earnings.
Investors are also awaiting minutes from the Federal Reserve meeting.
The reports could shape views on consumers and interest-rate policy.

articles.title: Meta and YouTube face damages after social media addiction verdict
bullets: A California jury found Meta and YouTube liable in a landmark case.
The plaintiff was awarded $3 million in damages, with punitive damages recommended.
Both companies disagreed with the verdict and said they would review legal options.

articles.title: Elliott stake puts PepsiCo under investor spotlight
bullets: CNBC reported Elliott took a $4 billion stake in PepsiCo.
PepsiCo appeared on CNBC’s market-movers coverage after the report.
Activist positions often draw attention to corporate strategy and capital allocation.

articles.title: Jury finds Instagram and YouTube liable in addiction trial
bullets: A California jury found Meta and YouTube liable in a first-of-its-kind case.
Jurors said platform design contributed to harm to a young user.
The decision could influence thousands of similar lawsuits.

articles.title: Parents press for changes after rulings against social media platforms
bullets: AP reported parents saw hope after back-to-back rulings against social media companies.
The cases focused on whether platforms failed to protect young users.
Families cited sextortion, addiction and mental-health harms.

articles.title: AP explains why wet phones should not be dried in rice
bullets: AP’s One Tech Tip advised against putting wet phones in rice.
The report explained safer steps for drying smartphones.
The guidance focuses on avoiding further device damage.

articles.title: HT examines why AI-generated answers need verification
bullets: Hindustan Times featured an explainer on checking machine-generated answers.
The story reflects rising attention to AI reliability and verification.
HT listed it among recent technology-adjacent explainers.

articles.title: HT unpacks PM Modi’s chips-and-minerals pledge
bullets: Hindustan Times highlighted an explainer on chips and minerals policy.
The piece noted three plants shipping and nine more coming.
The story was published within the prior day on HT’s homepage.
